description: Reads one file as being edited. Text comes as UTF-8, binaries as base64 (`encoding`). Large files come in chunks: while `hasMore`, call again with `offset` = `nextOffset` and join them before editing. Text files carry `version` for neblla_edit_file `baseVersion`. Changes nothing. More: neblla_get_llms tools/get_file

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

offset.description: Start, in characters of `content`: the previous `nextOffset`.

name: neblla_get_file
title: Read an app file
